title: Product Platform Engineer
description:
Skills –
**Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka / Amazon MSK, AWS and Azure cloud platforms, distributed data processing, data architecture, Docker, cloud storage (AWS S3 / Azure Blob), NoSQL databases, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, observability**

Job Description -

* 4–7 years of professional software engineering experience
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Apache Flink for distributed batch and real-time stream processing.
* Strong understanding of Apache Kafka / Amazon MSK, including topics, partitions, producers, consumers, consumer groups, retries and failure handling.
* Practical exposure to AWS and Azure cloud services, including AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage and cloud-based data integration.
* Understanding of data architecture patterns, including Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver and Gold layers).
* Experience with NoSQL databases and analytical data modelling concepts, including star-schema modelling.
* Understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous communication, API design and distributed systems.

As a Product Platform Engineer, you will:

* Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native platform components across AWS and Azure.
* Build event-driven ingestion and processing pipelines using MSK/Kafka, Flink, Spark, or AWS Glue.
* Implement reliable data movement across streaming, processing, and cloud storage layers such as S3 and Azure Blob Storage.
* Containerize services using Docker and support deployment into managed container platforms.
* Design microservices with clear boundaries, asynchronous communication, resilience, security, observability, and production supportability.
* Apply Medallion Architecture patterns across bronze, silver, and gold data layers.
* Use NoSQL databases appropriately and support analytical models where starschema patterns are required.To adhere to ISMS policiesand procedures
* Integrate AI/ML or GenAI services into enterprise applications through secure, governed, and observable interfaces.
* Collaborate with application, data, infrastructure, security, and AI/ML teams to deliver reusable platform capabilities.

**Engineering Practices:**

* API-first and event-driven design, including idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, and replayability.
* Infrastructure as Code and automated CI/CD practices; Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or equivalent exposure is desirable.
* Cloud security fundamentals: identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network controls, and least privilege.
* Observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.
* Unit, integration, contract, and performance testing for cloud and distributed workloads.
* Clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and design-decision records.

**Preferred / Desirable Skills:**

* Kubernetes, Amazon ECS/EKS, or Azure Kubernetes Service experience.
* Azure Event Hubs, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, or Azure Databricks exposure.
* AWS Lambda, ECS/Fargate, IAM, CloudWatch, Step Functions, and API Gateway exposure.
* Experience with schema management, data quality, lineage, metadata, governance, or catalog services.
* Understanding of distributed-system trade-offs, performance tuning, cost optimization, and production incident troubleshooting.

title: AI-Native Product Engineer
description:
**What we're building**
LX Nirvana is building a demand network for independent upscale, upper-upscale and luxury hotels outside the six major global hotel groups.
  
Each participating hotel runs its own LX Nirvana application, in its own brand. It knows each guest and sells to them before arrival and during the stay: rooms, dining, upgrades and the hotel's other services.
  
The platform runs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), integrates with the Oracle Hospitality Integration Platform (OHIP) and Oracle MICROS Simphony, and was built with Claude Code.
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for an exceptional hands-on engineer to take this platform forward.You will work directly with the founder, own the product's engineering, and use Claude Code as your core development tool. You will make the technical decisions, solve hard problems, and set the engineering practices as the company grows.
  
**What you will do**

* Move the platform to its new OCI setup, with each hotel group running in its own compartment
* Build and extend the integrations with Opera Cloud through OHIP, and with Simphony
* Ship features end to end, from the founder's designs to production
* Keep the platform running reliably in production: monitoring, alerts, and fixing the cause rather than the symptom
* Work with the language models the platform runs on, and the conversational system built on them
* Bring on a junior engineer and teach them to build the way you do

**Who you are**

* A full-stack engineer who has shipped production web applications end to end: server-rendered front ends, APIs, PostgreSQL, caching and cloud infrastructure
* You build with Claude Code every day, and you can show what you have built with it
* You own what you ship, including when it breaks at night
* You are comfortable making decisions with a founder, not waiting for a specification
* Hospitality or Oracle Hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement

**How to apply**
Send us three things: what you have built with Claude Code, where we can see it, and why this role is for you. That tells us more than a CV.
  
LX Nirvana Travel Technologies Limited is based in Dubai International Financial Centre. Its engineering is done in Kochi by Cordiant Traveltech Private Limited, which will be your employer.

The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy & Transformation practice. * AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering and Architecture Leadership

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
+ Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
+ Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
+ Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
+ Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
+ Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.

* Client & Stakeholder Management

+ Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.

+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.

* Cloud, Automation & Deployment Engineering Leadership

+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.

+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

* MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

* Asset and Accelerator Development

+ Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
+ Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

* Business Development & GTM Initiatives

+ Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
+ Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
+ Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

* Program Governance & Delivery Excellence

+ Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
+ Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
+ Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

* Practice Development & Team Leadership


+ Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
+ Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
+ Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Education:**

* B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).

**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming & APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security & Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect

* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications

* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi-cloud architecture programs.

title: Backend & Data Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At Fingent, we believe that technology can make a meaningful difference to the lives around us. The lives of those who use it, the lives of those who build it and to society at large. We create and provide software which is beautiful, usable and compelling, to solve complex business challenges. We nurture smart people who bring out the best in themselves, their peers, and their clients.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Hybrid Backend & Data Infrastructure Engineer to architect and scale the backend services and high-throughput data platforms that power our core products and analytical insights.
  
  
In this role, you will bridge the gap between software engineering, distributed systems, and data infrastructure. You will design high-performance microservices and APIs, orchestrate complex streaming and batch pipelines, automate cloud-native infrastructure, and solve hard distributed-systems challenges—such as multi-replica race conditions, state synchronization, and sub-second data processing.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Backend & Microservices Engineering

+ Architect, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable APIs and microservices using modern Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, uv).
+ Integrate foundational AI/LLM models and external services (e.g., AWS Bedrock).
+ Define resilient service interfaces, API schemas, and data contracts between internal engineering teams.

* Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management

+ Design robust state-management patterns to handle high-concurrency race conditions across worker pools, message queues, and database rows.
+ Implement distributed synchronization mechanisms (e.g., distributed locks/mutexes, idempotency keys, and optimistic/pessimistic locking strategies).
+ Ensure reliable execution, deduplication, and zero-data-loss guarantees across asynchronous task workers.

* Data Infrastructure & Orchestration

+ Develop and maintain scalable job orchestration workflows for streaming and batch processing using Celery, Dagster, or Apache Airflow.
+ Design, optimize, and maintain relational datastores (PostgreSQL) and in-memory caches (Redis).
+ Build modern analytical pipelines and data storage layers leveraging Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns.
+ Enforce end-to-end data quality, governance, schema evolution, and lineage across platforms.

* Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & CI/CD

+ Own, automate, and maintain cloud environments on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (CDKTF / Terraform).
+ Containerize services with Docker and manage deployments, auto-scaling (HPA), and load-balancing on Kubernetes (k8s) using Helm.
+ Build, maintain, and optimize secure GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment pipelines.

* Observability & Reliability Engineering

+ Ensure production uptime, high availability, and performance SLA/SLO benchmarks.
+ Build deep observability, tracing, and alerting stacks across all microservices and data pipelines using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience building and operating production backend services, distributed systems, or large-scale data platforms.
* Expertise in Python: Deep proficiency in the modern Python ecosystem (FastAPI, uv, async I/O, typing).
* Database & Caching Mastery: Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL (query optimization, ACID transactions, locking mechanisms, indexing) and Redis (caching strategies, pub/sub, distributed locks).
* Container & Cloud Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s), Docker, Helm, and AWS cloud architecture.
* Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Proven track record with CDKTF (Cloud Development Kit for Terraform) or Terraform.
* Workflow Orchestration: Production experience with pipeline orchestrators such as Dagster, Celery, or Apache Airflow.
* Observability: Practical experience instrumenting systems with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.
* Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Clear understanding of race conditions, deadlocks, consensus primitives, and message-queue semantics.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and CDC (Change Data Capture) via Debezium/Kafka.
* Exposure to MLOps workflows (MLflow, Feature Stores, embedding pipelines).
* Familiarity with consensus protocols and distributed coordination systems (Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd).
* Frontend familiarity with React, TypeScript, or Tailwind CSS.
* Active contributions to open-source software.

More Information
  
  

* Experience 5 - 10 Years

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Enterprise engineering - Java 8/11/17+, J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST APIs, microservices, design patterns, distributed systems
* Integration and platforms - API management, Kafka/RabbitMQ, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, service observability

* Cloud AI - At least one of Azure OpenAI / Azure AI, AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI, with working awareness of the other major clouds
* Operationalization - CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps/LLMOps, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, monitoring, tracing and production support
* Security and governance - Identity and access, OAuth/OIDC or SAML, data protection, AI safety, Responsible AI, model risk and secure AI service integration

title: GenAI Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled
**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**
to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:

+ Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
+ Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

* Solution Development:

+ Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
+ Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.
+ Develop and deploy generative AI models, particularly focusing on ChatGPT, using Python on Azure or AWS Platform or .Net on Azure platform
+ Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
+ Integration and Deployment:

* API Development:

+ Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
+ Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
+ Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
+ Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.

* Data Strategy and Preparation:

+ Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
+ Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.

* Innovation and Research:

+ Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
+ Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.

* Stakeholder Collaboration:

+ Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
+ Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
* Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

title: Reflections Info Systems - Senior Performance Engineer - JVM/Linux
description:
**Job Description**
6+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in Performance Engineering - Application Performance Management.
  
  
Proven experience troubleshooting complex performance issues in enterprise applications.
  
  
Strong understanding of JVM internals, memory management, threading, GC, CPU and I/O behavior.
  
  
Strong Linux troubleshooting skills.
  
  
Ability to independently perform performance analysis and identify root causes rather than only execute predefined performance test scripts.
  
  
Experience working with development, DevOps, infrastructure, and database teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Lead end-to-end application performance engineering and troubleshooting activities.
* Analyze application and server performance issues across development, test, and production environments.
* Perform detailed Linux system-level performance analysis, including CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, processes, and system resource utilization.
* Analyze JVM heap dumps to identify memory leaks, excessive object creation, and memory-related bottlenecks.
* Analyze thread dumps to identify deadlocks, thread contention, blocked/waiting threads, thread pool issues, and CPU-consuming threads.
* Perform Garbage Collection (GC) analysis, including GC logs, pause times, heap utilization, allocation patterns, and JVM tuning opportunities.
* Conduct database performance analysis, including slow queries, execution plans, connection pools, locks, waits, indexing, and database resource utilization.
* Generate and analyze flame graphs for identifying CPU hotspots and application-level performance bottlenecks.
* Use application and server-side monitoring/observability tools to identify performance degradation and correlate application, infrastructure, and database metrics.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of performance incidents and provide actionable recommendations.
* Work with development teams to identify inefficient code paths, resource utilization issues, memory problems, and concurrency-related bottlenecks.
* Define performance baselines and monitor application performance against agreed SLAs/SLOs.
* Lead performance optimization initiatives and validate improvements through benchmarking and load testing.
* Prepare technical performance reports, bottleneck analysis, and optimization recommendations.
* Mentor junior performance engineers and provide technical leadership across performance engineering initiatives.

**Primary Skills**
Candidates must have strong hands-on experience with:
  
  

* Linux - system-level troubleshooting and performance analysis
* Heap Dump Analysis
* Thread Dump Analysis
* Garbage Collection / GC Analysis
* Database Performance Analysis
* Flame Graphs
* Application-side Monitoring
* Server-side Monitoring
* JVM performance troubleshooting and tuning
* Application performance bottleneck identification
* Root-cause analysis and performance optimization

**Secondary Skills**

* Java/JVM performance engineering
* JProfiler, VisualVM, Eclipse MAT, YourKit or similar profiling tools
* Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus or similar observability platforms
* Splunk or ELK for log analysis
* APM and distributed tracing
* Kubernetes/container performance monitoring
* SQL performance tuning
* Load/performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling or similar
* CI/CD performance monitoring and engineering
* Cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or GCP

description:
**Role Summary**

Alight is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to design, build and operationalize enterprise AI solutions for Business Health, Commercial and Finance. Based in India, this hands-on technical leadership role will improve forecasting, planning, performance visibility and executive decision support.

You will combine structured commercial and financial data with enterprise knowledge to create predictive models, AI agents, retrieval solutions and automated workflows that help leaders understand performance, anticipate risk and act faster.

* Connect Salesforce, Clari, Power BI and enterprise content through governed GenAI, RAG and agentic workflows.

* Design, build, test, deploy and continuously improve enterprise GenAI, agentic AI and machine-learning solutions.

* Architect scalable LLM applications, AI agents, RAG systems, predictive solutions and supporting data and integration patterns.
* Develop high-quality Python applications, APIs, microservices, integrations and reusable components.

* Build AI agents that securely use enterprise data, tools, APIs, memory, orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Define evaluation approaches for accuracy, relevance, groundedness, safety, robustness, latency, scalability and business effectiveness.
* Implement CI/CD, observability, logging, monitoring, incident response, versioning, and performance and cost optimization.
* Apply security, privacy, governance, explainability, auditability and human oversight throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Create reference architectures, reusable patterns, coding standards, documentation expectations and AI engineering best practices.
* Lead technical workstreams, conduct architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and communicate decisions, risks, trade-offs and results.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering or a related discipline, supported by a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building and deploying GenAI, agentic AI, RAG or machine-learning solutions tied to defined outcomes.
* Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and time-series modelling, with hands-on experience in forecasting, trend analysis, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring across the ML lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of LLMs, prompt and context engineering, tool calling, orchestration, memory, multi-agent patterns and human-in-the-loop design.
* Experience with embeddings, vector databases, semantic or hybrid search, document processing, knowledge retrieval and grounded generation.
* Advanced Python skills and experience building production APIs, microservices, integrations, automated tests and maintainable software components.
* Experience deploying AI solutions on AWS, Azure or GCP using containers, Git, CI/CD, logging and monitoring.
* Experience evaluating and monitoring AI systems across quality, reliability, safety, security, privacy, model risk, performance, cost and business impact.
* Strong system-design, problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills.
* AWS Bedrock, SageMaker or comparable enterprise AI services.
* LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen or equivalent frameworks.
* Commercial and open-source model ecosystems.
* Complex, security-conscious or regulated enterprise environments.
* Reusable AI platforms, accelerators or reference architectures.

We offer you a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

* Experience integrating FCCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs or file-based integrations.
* Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
* Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.

* Oracle Cloud EPM Financial Consolidation and Close application configuration and administration
* Consolidation methods, ownership management, equity pickup, intercompany matching and eliminations
* Currency translation, CTA, historical rates, cash-flow statements, movement schedules and multi-GAAP reporting
* Configurable calculations, consolidation rules, member formulas, validation controls and performance optimisation
* Consolidation Journals, Enterprise Journals, Task Manager, Supplemental Data Manager and close orchestration
* Oracle Cloud EPM Reports, books, bursting, charts, grids, dashboards, Smart View and executive reporting packs
* Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and third-party ERP integrations
* Close-process controls, segregation of duties, audit trails, reconciliations and statutory reporting
* Awareness of AI-assisted close monitoring, anomaly detection, variance analysis and narrative commentary is desirable
* Strong analytical, accounting, problem-solving, documentation, teamwork and stakeholder communication skills
* Valid passport and willingness to travel to client locations and work MENA business timings, Sunday to Thursday

title: Senior AI/ML Specialist
description:
**Job title: AI/ML Senior Specialist**

**Location: Kochi (Hybrid)**

**Contract: Permanent, full-time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology

**About the Role**

Cyncly is establishing a dedicated AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) in Kochi, India, to build, fine-tune, and operationalize on-premises large language models across Cyncly's product suite. The AI/ML Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for training pipelines, fine-tuning domain-specific models, embeddings infrastructure, and integrating AI across five LLM use cases: product knowledge search, document intelligence, Service Desk ticket classification and resolution drafting, developer copilot assistance, and conversational product configuration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**LLM Fine-Tuning & Training Pipelines**

* Implement and maintain supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and RLHF pipelines for Cyncly domain-specific models, leveraging proprietary product catalogue, documentation, and support data.
* Apply LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning via Hugging Face PEFT; manage model checkpointing, hyperparameter tuning, and training run tracking. Work with quantised models (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) to optimise inference on GPU.
* Maintain reproducible experiments, model versioning, and artefact management using MLflow or Weights & Biases; collaborate with Data Engineering to curate and version domain datasets with PII scrubbing and data-quality checks.

**Embeddings Infrastructure & Semantic Search**

* Develop and optimise embedding pipelines using models such as BGE-M3 and E5-large; manage vector database ingestion, indexing strategies, and retrieval quality for Cyncly's product catalogues and documentation.
* Design, benchmark, and maintain vector database deployments (Qdrant, Weaviate, or equivalent), including index configuration, filtering strategies, and scalability planning.
* Implement retrieval quality metrics (MRR, NDCG, recall@k), run A/B evaluations of embedding model upgrades, and build hybrid search pipelines combining dense vector retrieval with BM25 sparse search to maximise product discovery accuracy.

**RAG Architecture & Use Case Integration**

* Design and implement RAG layers for Cyncly's five LLM use cases, ensuring context relevance, faithfulness, and latency targets; integrate MCP connectors to expose internal data sources and product APIs to the LLM inference layer.
* Build and maintain the developer copilot integration using Continue.dev and custom language-server extensions; implement prompt injection defenses, output filtering, and guardrail layers across all inference paths.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering squads to expose AI capabilities through REST/OpenAI-compatible APIs and integrate them into Cyncly's product surfaces.

**Model Evaluation & Quality Assurance**

* Write model evaluation harnesses and regression test suites; track and report quality metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, faithfulness score, hallucination rate, answer relevance) per deployed model and use case.
* Partner with the AI/ML QA team to design human evaluation workflows and validate model outputs before production release; maintain a model leaderboard and evaluation artefacts for all active models enabling data-driven decisions on upgrades and rollbacks.
* Implement continuous evaluation pipelines triggered on model updates, ensuring quality regressions are detected before reaching production.

**Inference Infrastructure & Observability**

* Deploy and manage LLM inference using vLLM or Text Generation Inference (TGI) on Cyncly's on-premises GPU infrastructure, targeting production-grade throughput and latency SLAs.
* Instrument inference latency, throughput (tokens/sec), GPU utilisation, and cost metrics; surface results to operational dashboards for the AI leadership team; participate in on-call rotation and incident response for model-serving issues.
* Contribute to the containerisation and orchestration of AI workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring deployments are reproducible, scalable, and integrated with Cyncly's CI/CD pipelines.

**Knowledge Graphs & Advanced Data Pipelines**

* Contribute to Cyncly's product knowledge graph (Neo4j) — entity-extraction pipelines, schema design, and graph query integration with RAG; build NLP pipelines to enrich product and document knowledge.
* Explore and prototype agentic AI patterns (tool use, multi-step reasoning) for complex information retrieval and action execution use cases.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8 years of hands-on software and/or AI/ML engineering experience, with at least 2 years working directly with large language models or transformer-based systems.
* Strong Python programming skills; proficiency with PyTorch or JAX training ecosystems, and Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT (LoRA, QLoRA), and model evaluation frameworks.
* Working knowledge of at least one vector database (Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, Chroma, or equivalent), including indexing, filtering, and retrieval optimisation; solid understanding of embedding models, semantic search quality metrics, and RAG architecture patterns.
* Experience building and consuming REST/OpenAI-compatible APIs; solid understanding of prompt engineering best practices including few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, and structured outputs.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), and experience working within CI/CD pipelines.

**Mandatory Technical Experience**

* **LLM Frameworks:**
  Proficiency in Python with the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT, Accelerate, Evaluate).
* **Fine-Tuning & Quantisation:**
  Experience with LoRA, QLoRA, and quantisation techniques (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) for on-premises model deployment.
* **Inference Serving:**
  Hands-on experience with vLLM, Text Generation Inference (TGI), or Ollama for production LLM serving.
* **Vector Databases & RAG:**

title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
  
  
*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You Will Do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have Qualifications**

* Technical
* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.
* Behavioral
* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
* Strong ownership of difficult investigations

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

title: Staff Architect
description:
We are looking for a Staff Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at organisation: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them.

**The Role**

You will help drive the technical direction of organisation's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns.

This role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Internal AI Engineering Platform**

* Help drive the architecture of organisation's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together.
* Co-design enterprise-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response.
* Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform.
* Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry.
* Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code.

**Client-Facing Product Architecture**

* Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of organisation's client-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features.
* Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event-driven patterns.
* Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved.
* Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable.
* Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation.
* Co-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency.
* Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on-call ergonomics and incident review.
* Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third-party services, data feeds and partner platforms.

**Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars**

* Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization.
* Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them.
* Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI-driven workflows and product features meet ORAGANISATION's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure.
* Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context.

**Essential Criteria**

* 11+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross-team scope.
* Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently.
* Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience.
* Hands-on experience architecting client-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability.
* Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary.
* Hands-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority.

As a Telecom Billing Domain Analyst, you will help clients assess, design and implement telecom BSS billing solutions. You will bring strong telecom billing-domain knowledge and hands-on experience with platforms such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or comparable telecom billing and monetization products. If you have hands-on experience for Aria Billing Cloud, it will be an added advantage.
  
  
You will work with a strong focus on providing managed services and stable production operations of deployed billing platforms. You will work with telecom customer’s business, IT, finance, operations and vendor teams to translate business requirements into practical billing processes and solution designs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the telecom billing-domain specialist across production support, managed services, consulting, implementation and migration engagements. Hands-on experience in Aria Billing Cloud will be a definitive advantage.

* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, operational efficiency, revenue assurance, customer experience and time to market.
* Work effectively with client stakeholders, product vendors, system integrators and distributed delivery teams.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops and document as-is and to-be billing processes, requirements, pain points, controls and business rules.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs, user stories, configuration requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support billing transformation decisions covering platform consolidation, legacy modernization, product and pricing migration, integration rationalization and phased decommissioning.
* Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
* Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
* Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
* Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4–8 years of experience in telecom BSS, with significant techno-functional, hands-on experience in billing and revenue management.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major billing platform such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or an equivalent platform. Hands-on experience on Aria Billing will be a definitive advantage.
* Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
* Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
* Should be willing to work in shifts
* Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, subscriptions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
* Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.
* Experience in production support or managed services for billing products, including incident, problem, change and release management; bill-cycle monitoring; root-cause analysis; defect resolution; and SLA-based support.
* Understanding of integrations between billing and CRM, order management, mediation, charging, product catalog, payment, tax, ERP/general ledger, customer-care and reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
* Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant TM Forum or billing-product certifications are an advantage.

**What We Look For**
Highly motivated telecom billing professionals who combine strong domain knowledge with hands-on delivery experience. You should be able to analyze complex billing scenarios, translate requirements into practical solutions and support clients through transformation, migration and production support operations while maintaining a clear focus on billing accuracy, revenue integrity and customer outcomes.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to design and guide the implementation of secure, scalable, and production-ready artificial intelligence solutions. This role will establish enterprise AI architecture, lead technical design decisions, and support the delivery of machine learning and generative AI capabilities across cloud and enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate combines strong architecture and software engineering experience with hands-on knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI governance, cloud platforms, and enterprise application integration.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Architecture and Delivery

* Design end-to-end architectures for machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of solutions involving large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing, automation, and predictive analytics.
* Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards for enterprise AI.
* Guide engineering teams in developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining AI solutions that support clinical, operational, and administrative use cases.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend appropriate platforms, models, tools, and implementation approaches.

Enterprise AI Infrastructure

* Design and optimize enterprise AI infrastructure across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Define architectural requirements for scalability, availability, security, reliability, and performance.
* Establish deployment, monitoring, and operational standards for AI workloads.
* Support platform health, system performance, capacity planning, and infrastructure readiness.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, security, data, and application teams to ensure architectural alignment.

Enterprise Systems Integration

* Design integration patterns connecting AI capabilities with enterprise applications, data platforms, healthcare systems, and business workflows.
* Define secure interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration patterns for AI-enabled solutions.
* Partner with business and technical teams to understand system dependencies and integration requirements.
* Support implementation teams in resolving complex integration and architectural challenges.

AI Governance, Security, and Responsible AI

* Establish AI quality, safety, security, privacy, and governance standards.
* Define evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, validation methods, and monitoring requirements for AI solutions.
* Ensure solutions comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI principles.
* Identify and mitigate technical, operational, security, privacy, and model-related risks.
* Incorporate human oversight, traceability, and appropriate controls into AI solution designs.

Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert supporting AI strategy, adoption, and solution implementation.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for business and executive stakeholders.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide technical direction to engineering and delivery teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and provide implementation guidance.
* Present findings, recommendations, architectural decisions, and solution options to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Collaborate across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Required Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combinations of education, relevant certifications, and professional experience may be considered.

Experience

* Minimum of
  **5 years of professional experience**
  in AI, machine learning, software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale AI or machine learning solutions.
* Experience developing solutions using Python and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with cloud-based AI services and infrastructure, including Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services, and Databricks.
* Experience with generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and business workflows.
* Experience establishing technical standards, reusable architecture patterns, or reference architectures.
* Experience moving AI solutions from proof of concept into secure and supportable production environments.

Required Knowledge and Skills

* Advanced knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI technologies.
* Strong understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Knowledge of AI solution architecture, system integration, application architecture, and data architecture.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, containerization, distributed systems, APIs, and modern deployment practices.
* Familiarity with structured and unstructured data management and analytics platforms, such as Databricks or comparable technologies.
* Knowledge of AI governance, model evaluation, validation methodologies, privacy, security, risk management, and responsible AI.
* Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions based on business, architectural, security, and operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, data, security, or AI certifications.
* Experience working in healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with healthcare data, clinical systems, or electronic health record environments.
* Experience implementing AI governance, model monitoring, or AI risk-management frameworks.
* Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams through AI solution design and production implementation

title: Salesforce Technical Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

The
**Salesforce Technical Manager**
will bridge strategic solution design, enterprise delivery leadership, and hands-on technical management. This role serves as a key technical leader overseeing cross-functional engineering teams to design, build, and deploy scalable, enterprise-grade multi-cloud Salesforce solutions (Sales, Service, Experience/Community, Data Cloud, and AI).

You will manage end-to-end technical execution, enforce strict technical governance, architect secure integrations with legacy/third-party systems, drive DevOps maturity, and directly mentor development teams to deliver zero-defect implementations aligned with client goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture, Multi-Cloud & Solution Design**

* Blueprint and architect robust, end-to-end multi-cloud Salesforce solutions (Sales, Service, Experience/Community, and Data Cloud) aligned with enterprise business requirements.
* Lead the technology selection, application design, configuration, and custom component design for high-performance platform execution.
* Evaluate AI-driven features (Data Cloud, Agentforce) and modern platform capabilities to design future-ready systems.

**2. Enterprise Integration & Data Management**

* Architect and oversee programmatic integration topologies connecting Salesforce to external platforms, legacy ERPs (e.g., SAP, Oracle), and third-party middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, Boomi, CTI).
* Direct secure API orchestration, Single Sign-On (SSO), OAuth, JWT, and large-scale data migrations.
* Oversee large data volume (LDV) strategies, sharing models, and privacy controls across multi-org environments.

**3. Technical Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Direct day-to-day technical team activities, supervising custom development in Apex, LWC, Visualforce, and Flow Orchestration.
* Run mandatory code review sessions, enforce bulkification and governor limit patterns, and eliminate platform bottlenecks.
* Mentor and coach technical team members through developer and architect certification pathways, fostering a high-quality delivery culture.

**4. DevOps, Quality & Technical Governance**

* Establish and drive CI/CD release and environment automation pipelines using tools such as Git, Jenkins, Copado, Flosum, or GitHub Actions.
* Participate in Architectural Review Boards (ARB) to critique, standardize, and approve solution designs.
* Enforce native platform security controls, environment segregation, and corporate IT compliance standards across all project tracks.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Advisory**

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client leadership, security boards, and key business stakeholders.
* Translate complex technical capabilities into strategic advice for non-technical business leaders.
* Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Project/Delivery Managers, and sales teams to validate SOWs and project delivery constraints.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Total Experience:**
  12+ years in technical software engineering and development, with a minimum of 8+ years focused explicitly on Salesforce platform development and architecture.
* **Multi-Cloud Expertise:**
  Proven track record architecting and delivering solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience/Community Cloud; familiarity with Data Cloud or Marketing Cloud is highly desirable.
* **Core Technical Mastery:**
  5+ years of hands-on experience building custom solutions using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Visualforce, and Salesforce APIs.
* **Integration & Security:**
  Deep experience with integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware orchestration, OAuth, SAML, and SSO.
* **DevOps & Release:**
  Demonstrated experience implementing automated CI/CD pipelines, source control strategies (Git), and sandbox/metadata management.
* **Methodology:**
  Proven history running technical delivery tracks in Agile frameworks across global onshore/offshore teams.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

**Preferred Certifications**

* **Architect Track:**
  Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect (CTA is a major advantage).
* **Development Track:**
  Platform Developer I & Platform Developer II.
* **Consulting/Cloud:**
  Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Data Cloud Consultant certifications.

* Experience managing budgets, delivery risk, and resource planning for complex programs.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and retain high‑performing technical teams.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

+ Support domain inputs across upstream analytics / AI solution areas such as:

- Reservoir performance analytics and forecasting
- Production surveillance / optimization linkages
- Well performance diagnostics and root cause analysis
- Decline analysis and anomaly detection
- Field development planning decision support

+ Review and validate analytics / AI outputs and dashboards for domain realism and engineering alignment; escalate concerns and recommendations to the Manager.

* 3–6 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong subsurface depth (Reservoir / Production / Petroleum Engineering).
* Practical understanding of subsurface workflows (not theory-only), including uncertainty handling and data quality considerations.
* Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate engineering concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams.
* Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning engineering / operations / digital teams.
* Fluency in English (mandatory).
* Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines
* Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models.

* Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts.
* Familiarity with engineering / digital tools (surveillance systems, production databases, BI tools).
* Arabic language capability (optional).
